item.title: SONIC THE HEDGEHOG 4 Casts FROZEN Star Kristen Bell As Amy Rose
item.description: Sonic the Hedgehog 4 has finally cast Amy Rose, with Frozen star and Disney Legend, Kristen Bell, set to bring the fan-favourite character to life in the Jeff Fowler-helmed movie.

item.title: SUICIDE SQUAD And MORBIUS Star Jared Leto's Name Appears In The Epstein Files: "[He] Did Very Well"
item.description: We're not sure how much of a surprise this will be given the actor's reputation, but Suicide Squad and Morbius star Jared Leto's name shows up in the notorious Epstein Files...

item.title: LEE CRONIN'S THE MUMMY Trailer Promises A Twisted New Take On The Classic Movie Monster
item.description: A new trailer and poster for Lee Cronin's The Mummy have risen today, and they promise a wild new take on the title character that's less Universal Movie Monster and more Evil Dead.

item.title: Doug Jones Shares His Review Of Julie Garner's Silver Surfer In THE FANTASTIC FOUR: FIRST STEPS (Exclusive)
item.description: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer star Doug Jones has shared his review of Julie Garner's take on Shalla-Bal in The Fantastic Four: First Steps and the pushback she received from some fans.

item.title: SLANTED: Swipe White With The First Trailer And Poster For New Body Horror Satire
item.description: The first trailer and poster for a new body horror satire starring Shirley Chen and Mckenna Grace have been released, and we're getting Mean Girls meets The Substance vibes...

item.title: MISSION: IMPOSSIBLE 9...Directed By Chloé Zhao? Tom Cruise Rumored To Have Enlisted ETERNALS Filmmaker To Helm
item.description: This is definitely a pretty out-there rumor, but Deuxmoi is reporting that Tom Cruise has reached out to Hamnet and Eternals director Chloé Zhao about helming a new Mission: Impossible movie...

item.title: THE HUNT FOR BEN SOLO Director Says It's "Insane" That Disney Wouldn't Make Adam Driver's STAR WARS Movie
item.description: Filmmaker Steven Soderbergh has criticised Disney for scrapping Adam Driver's Star Wars movie, The Hunt for Ben Solo, without even asking about the budget or any other details.

item.title: STAR TREK: STARFLEET ACADEMY Episode 7 Trailer Teases A Shift In Focus After Last Week's Deadly Twist
item.description: Paramount+ has revealed the trailer and a batch of stills from this week's episode of Star Trek: Starfleet Academy. Titled "Ko'Zeine," Episode 7 follows our cadets home for a holiday break.
